title: Transposition of an ordinary homology square by scalar extension
statement: Let $E,F,D$ be commutative rings, $f:E\to D$ and $g:F\to D$ ring homomorphisms, $M$ an $E$-module and $N$ an $F$-module [def-weil-module-base-change]. Let $X,Y$ be cochain complexes of $E$- and $F$-modules, $X_D,Y_D$ cochain complexes of $D$-modules, and $i\in\mathbf Z$. Suppose $a:M\to H^i(X)$, $b:N\to H^i(Y)$, coefficient maps $v_X:X\to(X_D)_E$, $v_Y:Y\to(Y_D)_F$, and $D$-linear maps $a_D:D\otimes_E M\to H^i(X_D)$, $b_D:D\otimes_F N\to H^i(Y_D)$ have adjoint transposes $a;H^i(v_X);s_{X_D,E}$ and $b;H^i(v_Y);s_{Y_D,F}$, respectively. Here $s$ denotes the canonical homology isomorphism for restriction of scalars. Write $U$ for forgetting scalar actions. Suppose an additive map $c:UM\to UN$ and additive chain map $\phi:UX\to UY$ satisfy $U(a);s_{X,U}^{-1};H^i(\phi)=c;U(b);s_{Y,U}^{-1}$. Suppose a $D$-linear chain map $\tau:X_D\to Y_D$ satisfies $U(v_X);U(\tau)=\phi;U(v_Y)$. Finally suppose $e:D\otimes_E M\to D\otimes_F N$ is $D$-linear and sends $1\otimes m$ to $1\otimes c(m)$ for every $m$. Then $a_D;H^i(\tau)=e;b_D$. No map is assumed invertible and $D$ is not assumed flat.

proof.text: Prove compatibility of mapHomologyIso with homologyπ from LeftHomologyData.mapHomologyIso_eq, mapCyclesIso_eq and π_comp_homologyIso_inv. Prove the two-stage cycles identification by cancellation against the mono image of iCycles. Cancel the epi homologyπ and use its compatibility to prove the two-stage homology identification. All helpers are proved private lemmas.

Forget both adjunction identities, use homology naturality and the two-stage identification to rewrite their values through additive ordinary homology. Apply homology to the given coefficient-complex square. Compose it with the assumed ordinary cohomology square, using naturality for tau to transport the target homology identifications. The result equates the additive transposes. Test the desired D-linear maps on 1 tensor m, substitute he and evaluate that equality.

theorem scalarExtension_homology_square
    (E F D : Type u) [CommRing E] [CommRing F] [CommRing D]
    (f : E →+* D) (g : F →+* D)
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} E) (N : ModuleCat.{u} F)
    (X : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} E) ℤ)
    (Y : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} F) ℤ)
    (XL YL : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} D) ℤ) (i : ℤ)
    (a : M ⟶ X.homology i) (b : N ⟶ Y.homology i)
    (vX : X ⟶ ((restrictScalars f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj XL)
    (vY : Y ⟶ ((restrictScalars g).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj YL)
    (aD : (extendScalars f).obj M ⟶ XL.homology i)
    (bD : (extendScalars g).obj N ⟶ YL.homology i)
    (ha : (extendRestrictScalarsAdj f).unit.app M ≫ (restrictScalars f).map aD =
      a ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap vX i ≫
        (XL.sc i |>.mapHomologyIso (restrictScalars f)).hom)
    (hb : (extendRestrictScalarsAdj g).unit.app N ≫ (restrictScalars g).map bD =
      b ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap vY i ≫
        (YL.sc i |>.mapHomologyIso (restrictScalars g)).hom)
    (c : (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} E) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj M ⟶
      (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} F) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj N)
    (φ : ((forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} E) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj X ⟶
      ((forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} F) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Y)
    (hφ : (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} E) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map a ≫
        (X.sc i |>.mapHomologyIso (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} E) AddCommGrpCat.{u})).inv ≫
          HomologicalComplex.homologyMap φ i =
      c ≫ (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} F) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map b ≫
        (Y.sc i |>.mapHomologyIso (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} F) AddCommGrpCat.{u})).inv)
    (τ : XL ⟶ YL)
    (hv : ((forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} E) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map vX ≫
        ((forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} D) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map τ =
      φ ≫ ((forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} F) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map vY)
    (e : (extendScalars f).obj M ⟶ (extendScalars g).obj N)
    (he : ∀ m : M, e ((1 : D) ⊗ₜ[E,f] m) = (1 : D) ⊗ₜ[F,g] (show N from c m)) :
    aD ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap τ i = e ≫ bD
